name: 54636 · Holmen, WI
findings: ZIP 54636 (Holmen) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54636 (Holmen) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
